name: Olga Petrova
headline: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
summary: Site reliability engineer with 9 years on telecom and logistics platforms. Returned to work in 2022 after a two-year career break for family care.

experience.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
bullets: Run 12 production Kubernetes clusters on AWS for a freight-booking platform with a 99.95% availability target.
Rewrote the infrastructure as Terraform modules shared by six teams, removing 2,000 lines of copy-pasted config.
Standardised deployments on Helm charts with automated canary analysis, halving failed releases.
Built Prometheus SLO alerting and wrote a small Go exporter for queue depth on the booking pipeline.

experience.title: Site Reliability Engineer
bullets: Automated provisioning for 800 Linux servers with Ansible, cutting new-site setup from a week to a day.
Led the move of the first workloads to AWS, writing the Terraform for networking and IAM.
Built Grafana dashboards for the network operations centre covering 4 million subscribers.
Wrote Bash tooling for on-call runbooks and log collection.
